title: StockBee
tagline: AI-powered stock intelligence designed to help traders spot opportunities the moment they emerge.
disciplines: Product Strategy · Product Design · Brand · Visual Direction

sections.heading: Markets move fast. Information moves faster.
body: The challenge isn't finding information. It's knowing what matters, when it matters, and what to do with it.
News, filings, research, and market tools are scattered across platforms. By the time traders piece together the story, the opportunity may already be gone.
sections.statement: StockBee was built to close that gap.

media.alt: Meet StockBee — a phone showing a Tata Motors alert up 14% since the news

sections.heading: StockBee turns market events into real-time intelligence through WhatsApp alerts, AI-powered summaries, deep-dive analysis, and a live market command centre.
sections.statement: The goal: reduce the distance between information and understanding.

sections.heading: Traders don't have time to read reports.
body: StockBee turns raw market events into concise signals, combining price movement, sentiment, context, and AI-generated summaries.
Reveal just enough to create awareness. Go deeper when the decision calls for it.

media.alt: Four StockBee capabilities: real-time scanning, lightning-fast WhatsApp delivery, smart summaries and precision filtering
Lightning-fast stock updates, delivered to your WhatsApp

sections.heading: A fast alert creates awareness. A confident decision needs context.
body: Each signal expands into financial performance, market impact, sentiment, source attribution, and AI-generated analysis.
The challenge was finding the right depth without slowing the experience down.

media.alt: Uptrend list: stocks, CMP and day change
The live update feed on a tablet
An earnings-call summary on the phone

sections.heading: StockBee couldn't only help traders react. It needed to help them discover what was happening across the market.
body: Trader's Den brings momentum, breakouts, sector movements, derivatives activity, and market-wide signals into one real-time command centre.

media.alt: StockBee Terminal: your trading command centre
No Noise: StockBee Spotlight, sector surge, breakout tracker
F&O table with option chain data

sections.heading: In financial products, speed without confidence isn't enough.
body: Source attribution, sentiment, market impact, hierarchy, and visual cues help users move quickly without losing context.

media.alt: The update funnel: key updates, analytical updates, event schedules, promotions

sections.heading: StockBee needed to feel like one product everywhere.
body: I shaped the visual direction across the product, WhatsApp experience, marketing, and brand identity, creating a system that could scale with the platform.
A dark, high-contrast foundation, vibrant signal colours, restrained typography, and data-led visual cues give StockBee a distinct and consistent character.

media.alt: Get started with StockBee in three steps
Edit your stock list: 24 stocks tracked

sections.heading: As StockBee grew from concept into a full product, the work expanded beyond individual screens.
body: I helped shape feature direction, experience principles, design systems, and visual consistency across the team, while working closely with product and engineering through launch.
sections.statement: The goal was to make the whole product make sense together.

media.alt: As seen in Business Today, India Today, MSN, Yahoo Finance, Rediff, Business Standard, The Tribune
Enterprise solutions: custom insights, scalable impact

result.heading: The result
body: StockBee turns fragmented market information into a faster, more connected intelligence experience.
It moves the trader from “What happened?” to “Why does it matter?”
result.statement: Less time finding information. More time understanding what matters.
